title: FrontierMath Erdős: Benchmark of 68 Open Mathematical Conjectures for AI Reasoning
summary: FrontierMath Erdős (FME) is a benchmark containing 68 open mathematical conjectures formalized in Lean that challenge AI systems to prove or disprove unsolved problems. Evaluated models received a $300 budget per problem; GPT-6 Astra scored 3%, all others scored 0%.
takeaways: 68 open Erdős problems formalized in Lean proof assistant
Selected from 652 open problems on Erdős Problems website
$300 budget per problem for AI evaluation
GPT-6 Astra scored 3%; all other models scored 0%

title: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash: Multimodal Agentic Model for Real-World Productivity
summary: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, a natively multimodal agentic model designed for real-world productivity tasks. The model features a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture and one million token context window for long-horizon reasoning.
takeaways: Sparse MoE architecture from Qwen3.8-Next
One million token context window
Native multimodal co-training strategy preserves text capabilities
Intended for video editing, audio/video translation, music-conditioned generation
Accompanied by Qwen-MM-Plugins and Qwen-Live-Harness frameworks

title: Islamic State Uses Big Tech AI Tools to Develop Explosive Devices
summary: University of Cambridge research, based on interviews with 27 former Boko Haram fighters, found that ISIL affiliates are using AI chatbots from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and other companies to build bombs, plan attacks, and solve combat problems. Fighters were trained to bypass AI safety cont
takeaways: ISWAP and JAS fighters using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Meta AI, and DeepSeek
ISWAP operatives trained in rooms with laptops and projectors to query AI and bypass safeguards
Accounts with paid subscriptions set up for fighters on multiple AI platforms
Pro-ISIL forum sharing instructions on bypassing AI safety controls
Research based on interviews with 27 former Boko Haram faction members
Aligns with February UN Security Council warning on ISIL using advanced AI

title: Anthropic and Nvidia back Basecamp Research in $140M Series C funding
summary: Basecamp Research raised $140 million in Series C funding led by S32 with participation from Anthropic's Anthology Fund and Nvidia's NVentures. The London-based life sciences startup uses AI and biodiversity data to design treatments for cancer and autoimmune diseases, bringing total funding to $225
takeaways: $140 million Series C round led by S32 (Bill Maris' firm)
Anthropic's Anthology Fund joined as new investor; Nvidia NVentures returned
Total funding now $225 million since founding in 2019
Uses AI and biodiversity data to design cancer and autoimmune treatments
Funding supports training new Eden biological foundation AI models

title: Monocultural Biases in LLMs Create Systemic Hiring Discrimination
summary: Correlated biases in widely-deployed language models homogenize discrimination across hiring systems, creating unequal exclusion rates.
takeaways: Agentic language reduced female candidate recommendations (r_rb=0.309, p=7×10⁻⁵)
Coded-exclusion language suppressed non-White recruiter scores at large effect sizes (r_rb=0.646–0.758)
Models tested: Llama 3.2, Mistral, Gemma 3, Qwen 3, Phi 3, DeepSeek-R1
Research translates to pre-deployment audit protocol under EU AI Act Annex III high-risk classification and US EEOC adverse-impact analysis
Paper accepted at 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
updatesTitle: Gender and Racial Bias in Open-Weight LLMs for Recruitment

title: Fairness Beyond Anonymization: Demographic Leakage in LLM-Generated Resumes
summary: German-language LLMs leak demographic information in automatically generated resumes despite anonymization efforts, using subtle differences in semantically equivalent terms. The finding raises concerns about fairness interventions in multilingual AI hiring pipelines under the EU AI Act, which class
takeaways: ChatGPT (GPT-4o-mini), Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, and Qwen 3 models (4B–14B parameters) tested
Classifiers reliably distinguished resumes generated with male vs. female names despite anonymization
Leakage driven by subtle gender-neutral term usage in German, not overtly gendered wording
Ethnicity-related leakage remained weak across all tested models

title: PII-TRACE: Benchmark for Context-Aware PII Detection in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations
summary: PII-TRACE benchmark evaluates PII detection across 13,148 multi-turn dialogues in 13 languages, revealing that no current detector achieves full coverage without false positives. A new 600M-parameter PII-Tracer model outperforms existing systems on entity-level coverage.
takeaways: 13,148 synthetic multi-turn conversations with character-level annotation spans and identifier clusters
No detector achieves full entity-level coverage without substantial false positives on PII-free conversations
Single-pass reading misses approximately one-third of gold characters in long dialogues
PII-Tracer (0.6B parameters) trained with conversation-level supervision achieves highest entity-level coverage

title: How the UK should protect its science and tech research from foreign state threats
summary: A policy analysis of strategies the United Kingdom should employ to safeguard scientific and technological research from state-sponsored foreign threats.
updatesTitle: UK Strategy for Protecting Science and Tech Research From Foreign State Threats

title: Georgia Tech researchers identify new layer of human genome structure
summary: Georgia Tech researchers discovered a previously unknown structural layer of the human genome: small RNA molecules embedded in DNA during normal cellular activity. The team mapped these ribonucleotides across the genome, finding they concentrate near active genes and modulate DNA supercoiling, sugge
takeaways: Study published in Cell, August 2026
Ribonucleotides distributed in distinct patterns, dubbed the human nuclear 'ribome'
Embedded RNA especially common near gene starting points and increases with gene activity
RNA molecules influence DNA supercoiling, connected to transcription
May help explain rare autoimmune disorders linked to RNA removal problems

title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Advanced KV Cache Compression
summary: DeepSeek released V4.1-Flash, a model variant using aggressive key-value cache compression to reduce inference costs for long-context applications. The technique minimizes memory and computational overhead when processing longer sequences.
takeaways: Aggressively compresses KV caches for long-context inference
Reduces memory and computational requirements for longer sequences
Submitted to arXiv September 17, 2026

title: EviStreams: Human-in-the-Loop AI for Systematic Review Data Extraction
summary: A system automates data extraction from medical studies for systematic reviews through human-in-the-loop AI, reducing the expert-labor bottleneck in the protocol-driven extraction workflow.

title: Audit Reveals Shortcut Learning Inflates Accuracy in Fake News Detection Models
summary: Researchers demonstrate that text classifiers trained on the widely-used ISOT/Kaggle fake news corpus achieve misleadingly high accuracy by exploiting shortcut patterns rather than learning genuine veracity signals.

title: AIBuildAI-2.5: LLM-Guided Tree Search for Autonomous AI Model Development
summary: An autonomous agent system uses LLM-guided tree search to automatically build AI models, broadening access across science and engineering.

title: FinFIRST: Benchmarking LLM Search Agents for Financial Information Retrieval
summary: A benchmark evaluates LLM search agents on financial tasks requiring temporally valid information, authoritative sources, and strict consistency checks.

title: Evaluating LLM Behavior Under Social Pressure and User Manipulation
summary: A study of 60 language models examines how models respond when users apply pressure—whether they abandon correct facts, refuse appropriately, or pursue harmful plans.

title: Matryoshka Attribution: Tracing LLM Outputs to Internal Representations and Weights
summary: A method attributes language model outputs to specific internal representations and weight matrices, advancing mechanistic interpretability.

title: Google Releases Gemini 3.8 Text-to-Speech Model
summary: Google launched Gemini 3.8, a new text-to-speech model advancing conversational AI capabilities.

title: The Role of AI in Online Reviews: Manipulation and Platform Risk
summary: Language models enable strategic content generation for online reviews, creating new manipulation vectors that threaten platform integrity.

title: Dissecting Training-Free Uncertainty Estimation in Multimodal LLMs
summary: A study analyzes how to quantify predictive uncertainty in multimodal language models without retraining, critical for safety-critical applications.

title: MAGS: Multi-agent auto-formalization guarantees safety for agentic outputs
summary: Researchers introduced MAGS, a method for verifying the safety of code generated by LLM agents through multi-agent auto-formalization.

title: Closed-world resolution addresses tool hallucination in LLM agents
summary: Researchers proposed a defense mechanism against tool hallucination, where LLM agents call non-existent tools or pass invalid arguments.

title: D-Quant: Driftable Entropy Coding for KV Cache Quantization
summary: Researchers introduce D-Quant, a quantization technique to compress KV caches in large language models and reduce memory footprint.

title: UK Strategy for Protecting Scientific and Technology Research from Foreign State Threats
summary: British policy analysis examines safeguards needed to defend national science and technology research from state-sponsored espionage and interference.

title: NSF Invests $90M in Three New Science and Technology Centers
summary: The National Science Foundation awards $90 million to establish three new Science and Technology Centers focused on transformative research.

title: Virginia Tech receives $20 million grant for cloud-based semiconductor lab
summary: Virginia Tech has secured a $20 million grant to develop a cloud-based laboratory for semiconductor research and education.

title: AI agents influencing product decisions without explicit authorization, warns research firm
summary: Info-Tech Research Group warns that AI agents are influencing product and business decisions without explicit human authorization.

title: Distilling Sequential Computation: Speeding Transformer Inference by Compressing Predictable Token Spans
summary: A method reduces transformer inference cost by recognizing that many adjacent token spans are highly predictable and can be processed as stable units rather than token-by-token.

title: Planned Test-Time Scaling with Coordinated Reasoning Paths
summary: A method improves test-time scaling by coordinating parallel reasoning branches rather than drawing them independently, reducing redundancy in reasoning attempts.

title: Parallel Speculative Decoding: Concurrent Drafting and Verification in Transformer Inference
summary: A method overlaps the draft and verification phases of speculative decoding to remove serialized drafting from the critical path of token generation.

title: Uncheatable Eval: Dynamic Compression-Based Language Model Evaluation Resistant to Data Leakage
summary: A dynamic compression-based evaluation method makes it difficult for language models to memorize benchmark data, addressing benchmark contamination risks.

title: Brain-to-Language Decoding: Methods and Applications for Communication Restoration
summary: A comprehensive survey of brain-to-language decoding systems that translate neural activity into linguistic outputs for speech restoration and cognitive research.

title: LabourCrew: Multi-Agent RAG Framework for Statutory Reasoning Over Labour Law
summary: A multi-agent system with adversarial deliberation ensures that every claim in labour law question answering is traceable to verified evidence, not merely relevant.

title: Study finds AI agents lack consistency on repeated tasks
summary: Research shows that AI agents return inconsistent answers 38–74% of the time when performing the same task multiple times.

title: PAGE: KV-cache eviction method for language model optimization
summary: A new framework reframes token eviction decisions as per-input admission controls to improve language model accuracy under compression.

title: LLM agents and classic psychological effects: contamination analysis study
summary: A new benchmark examines whether LLM agents genuinely exhibit human psychological biases or merely reproduce response patterns.

title: Fine-tuned LLMs for maternal and vaccination health in African settings
summary: Study evaluates domain-specific LLM fine-tuning for delivering accurate, culturally appropriate maternal and vaccination health guidance in low-resource African contexts.

title: MedNotes: Multi-Agent Pipeline for Synthetic Clinical Note Generation from EHR Data
summary: A system converts sparse structured electronic health records into source-grounded synthetic clinical notes using multi-agent workflows.

title: SCoR: Hierarchical Framework for Forecasting Scientific Concept Relations
summary: A method predicts emerging scientific research directions by modeling how concepts will relate in future literature.

title: HERMES: knowledge graph reasoning from clinical notes for patient outcome prediction
summary: Researchers introduced HERMES, a method leveraging knowledge graphs and clinical notes to predict patient outcomes more accurately than sequence-based approaches.

title: TALON: temporally aware framework for longitudinal radiology report generation
summary: Researchers presented TALON, a model that generates radiology reports with temporal awareness to enable meaningful longitudinal comparisons between patient examinations.

title: Study uses LLMs to identify Kubernetes misconfigurations in cloud-native environments
summary: Researchers demonstrate how large language models can detect security misconfigurations in Kubernetes deployments to improve cloud-native infrastructure security.

title: Deep Research Agent Training via Self-Generated Rollout Traces for Extended Context
summary: A technique using reinforcement learning on self-generated reasoning traces improves agentic deep research and long-context handling.

title: MME-Safety: Fine-Grained Safety Benchmark for Multimodal Language Models
summary: A new fine-grained safety benchmark evaluates vulnerabilities in multimodal LLMs that bypass unimodal content filters.

title: ArenaFlow: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for Open-Ended LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: A trajectory ranking and hierarchical credit propagation method extends reinforcement learning to open-ended agent tasks without scalar rewards.

title: UK Strategy for Protecting Science and Tech Research From Foreign State Threats
summary: Report examines how the UK should safeguard scientific and technological research from hostile state actors.

title: Safety detection in LLMs via latent state analysis without external interfaces
summary: Researchers developed methods to detect harmful outputs in large language models by analyzing internal latent states rather than relying on external safety layers.
updatesTitle: ForeSight Detects Safety Risks in LLM Generation Through Early Signal Distillation

title: PetriBench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning over Dynamic State Spaces
summary: PetriBench, a new benchmark, measures how well language models reason about evolving environments without relying on external knowledge.

title: Goal-oriented agentic AI enables non-expert users to repair ubiquitous robots via natural language
summary: A goal-oriented agentic AI architecture enables non-expert users to perform maintenance and repairs on ubiquitous robots through natural language interaction without visual interfaces.

title: SR-Fraud: outcome-supervised LLM agent for real-time payment fraud detection
summary: Researchers introduce an outcome-supervised reflective LLM agent framework designed to detect non-stationary payment fraud patterns in real-time streaming systems.

title: COMED: Bridging Routing and Collaboration in Multi-LLM Inference Systems
summary: A new approach addresses the gap between routing and output combination in multi-model LLM inference systems.

title: dSTAR: Straggler Tolerant and Byzantine Resilient Distributed SGD
summary: A new distributed training algorithm addresses stragglers and Byzantine failures in multi-node gradient aggregation.

title: BI-Agent and BI-Bench: Automating End-to-End Business Intelligence
summary: Researchers introduce an agent and benchmark for automating data preparation and analysis workflows in business intelligence tools.

title: Scaling Discovery through Test-Time Communication
summary: Research demonstrates that allowing AI agents to communicate at test time substantially improves collaborative scientific discovery.

title: ASGARD: Action-Space Guard for UAV Resilience via Reinforcement Learning
summary: A defense mechanism protects reinforcement-learning-controlled drones from action-space attacks that intercept and override policy commands.

title: Georgia Tech Researchers Present AI Cyber Challenge Findings at USENIX Security 2026
summary: Researchers from Georgia Tech have shared lessons learned from an AI-focused cybersecurity challenge at the USENIX Security conference.

title: Six AI Code Generation Tools Named Champions in 2026 Emotional Footprint Report
summary: Info-Tech Research Group has identified six AI code generation solutions as leading performers in emotional impact and developer satisfaction metrics.

title: Georgia Tech and Pacific Northwest National Laboratory Expand Research Partnership
summary: Georgia Tech and the Pacific Northwest National Laboratory have signed an agreement to deepen their strategic research collaboration.
